description: Checks one email address the way a signup form would: invalid syntax, disposable/throwaway domain, domain that cannot receive mail (no MX), likely typo with a suggested fix (e.g. gmial.com -> gmail.com), privacy relay (Apple Hide My Email, Firefox Relay: allowed, they reach a real inbox) and role addresses. Returns a verdict (allow, suggest, warn, block) with reasons.

email.description: The email address to check, e.g. jane@gmial.com

name: check_email
title: Check a signup email
